title: klein-four-symmetry
description: The Klein-four group K_4 = Z/2 x Z/2 acting on a bilattice equipped with both negation and conflation, generated by these two commuting involutions; its four elements (id, negation, conflation, negation-after-conflation) act distinctly on the knowledge and truth orders.

bilattice.description: the bilattice acted upon, carrying both a knowledge order and a truth order

negation.description: ~ : preserves <=_k, reverses <=_t (the internal Z/2 gauge); an involutive generator

elements.description: the four group elements {id, ~, -, ~o-}; ~o- reverses both orders (coordinatewise complement)

generatorsCommute.description: ~ o - = - o ~, by the bilattice axiom that negation and conflation commute when both are present

isKleinFour.description: K_4 = <~, -> is isomorphic to Z/2 x Z/2: two commuting order-two involutions
